title: Sound Macros
wikitext: == Disable audio == Disable audio for macro to cast spell /console Sound_EnableSFX 0 /script if GetUnitName("target")==nil then TargetNearestEnemy() end /cast Fireball /console Sound_EnableSFX 1 /script UIErrorsFrame:Clear(); == Error sound == Error sound off /Console MasterSoundEffects 0 Error sound on /Console MasterSoundEffects 1 == Error Speech == Disable Error Speech (SetCVar) /run SetCVar("EnableErrorSpeech", 0) UIErrorsFrame:UnregisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" CastSpellByName"SPELLNAME" UIErrorsFrame:RegisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" SetCVar("EnableErrorSpeech", 1) Disable Error Speech (Console) /console EnableErrorSpeech 0 /run UIErrorsFrame:UnregisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" /run CastSpellByName"SPELLNAME" /run UIErrorsFrame:RegisterEvent"UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" /console EnableErrorSpeech 1 == Play Sound == Play the Raid Warning sound /run PlaySound ("RaidWarning"); Play Raid Warning sound if target exist /run if UnitExists("target") then PlaySound ("RaidWarning"); else end Check that you have proper druid HoT on you /script local i=0 g=GetPlayerBuff while not(g(i) == -1)do if(strfind(GetPlayerBuffTexture(g(i)), "Spell_Nature_Rejuvenation"))then PlaySoundFile("Sound\Creature\Ossirian\OssirianIAmRejuvenated.wav")end i=i+1 end == Sound Tweaks == Enter each of these commands in-game and then restart your client. /console SoundMemoryCache 128 /console SoundMaxHardwareChannels 128 /console SoundSoftwareChannels 128 put compatibility option to XP SP3 if you get sound issues You can add this one if you want too: /console SoundMixRate 48000 == Sound channels == Set in game: /run SetCVar("Sound_NumChannels",128) Confirm its done: /dump GetCVar("Sound_NumChannels") You can add 2 lines to your config.wtf - that way you dont need a modified .exe - the lines to add are SET SoundMaxHardwareChannels "256" and "SET SoundSoftwareChannels "256" - change the number 256 to the channels you want. I have it set to the max of 256. [[Category:Macros]]
